name: T0 tennis baseline
description: Frozen baseline of the Roland Garros tennis pipeline after the May 31 totals/first-set O-U fix. This is a reproducibility lock, not a claim that the model is good.
components: warehouse score fallback from live rank, 2026 clay record, opponent-adjusted form, and service weakness
pandas multimodel ensemble rows when available
FanDuel moneyline, spread, match total, first-set total, and set-win value books
Kalshi trade-to-sell candidates as separate prediction-market lane
notes: Future T1+ cartridges should be compared against this May 31 snapshot before any behavior change is accepted.
ML, spread, match O-U, first-set O-U, set-win, and Kalshi lanes must be tracked separately.
